page.title: Lessons
page.tagline: What this workspace has learned, and the changes it made to act on it.

empty.title: No lessons yet
empty.description: The Lesson Learner files these after reviewing finished work. Run a retrospective, or finish work an agent helped with and you'll be offered one.

empty.title: Nothing reviewed yet
empty.description: A retrospective reads work that is already finished and looks for what should change about how the agents here work.

affected.title: Agents this would change
affected.none: No agent uses this skill right now, so nothing would change today.

stale.title: This proposal is out of date
stale.description: The skill has changed since this was written, so it can no longer be adopted as it stands. Ask for it to be written again against the current version.

decision.reason_placeholder: Why you are adopting or turning this down. Kept with the decision.
decision.warning: Adopting this changes the skill immediately. Every future run by the agents above reads the new version.

withdraw.description: Withdrawing puts the skill back the way it was, unless it has been changed since — in which case that work is left alone.
withdraw.reason_placeholder: Why this is being withdrawn. Required.

not_found.title: Lesson not found
not_found.description: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another workspace.

diff.name: Name
diff.no_changes: This proposal does not change anything.

issue_bar.title: Learn from this?
issue_bar.description: Agents worked on this. A retrospective reads what happened and proposes changes to how they work.
issue_bar.running: The Lesson Learner is reviewing this now.

versions.title: Versions
versions.restore_confirm: Restore this version? The current text is kept in the history, so this can be undone.
